issue.title: ASAN use-after-poison in grpc_core::StatusSetTime (or absl TimeZoneInfo?)

repository.name: grpc
repository.description: C++ based gRPC (C++, Python, Ruby, Objective-C, PHP, C#)

issue.body:
While running our gRPC server with ASAN, we often see this use-after-poison error occur. Valgrind does not show a problem though.

### What version of gRPC and what language are you using?

I tried v1.61.1 and v1.64.0.

### What operating system (Linux, Windows,...) and version?

I'm reproducing this on Ubuntu 22.04.

### What runtime / compiler are you using (e.g. python version or version of gcc)

Default GCC 11.4.0

### What did you do?

I could not extract a minimal example to reproduce this yet. I'm hoping the backtrace is enough of a hint for you. If not, I will try to create a setup to reproduce.

I would be interested how to further debug this to get to the bottom of it.

### What did you expect to see?

ASAN shouldn't trigger, obviously.
